Research software.name: DOPPLERGEIST
Research software.summary: Local Python software that compares aircraft Doppler signatures in recordings with historical ADS-B flight paths.
Research software.detail: The method and field notes describe what the search can establish, including its inconclusive Livermore result.

Research software.name: Doubly charged Higgs search
Research software.summary: Student research with Nathan Catlett on estimating background in a doubly charged Higgs search when high-mass simulations are sparse.
Research software.detail: The IMSA Student Inquiry and Research abstract records the project and its scope. The software work is part of the IMSA–CMS collaboration with Dr. Peter Dong.

Research software.name: IncidentMesh
Research software.summary: An incident-response prototype that uses parallel investigations and revises proposed actions as shared evidence changes.
Research software.detail: The case study traces stages of a prototype incident and shows why an earlier proposal can become stale after new evidence arrives.

Mathematics and formal verification.name: Solved Conjectures
Mathematics and formal verification.summary: A collection of proofs, counterexamples and partial results in combinatorics and number theory, with per-result Lean status.
Mathematics and formal verification.detail: The notes are unrefereed. Individual entries record scope, source statements and available verification.

Mathematics and formal verification.name: Deterministic integer factoring
Mathematics and formal verification.summary: Deterministic worst-case integer factoring bounds and a Lean proof of the square-root logarithmic saving.
Mathematics and formal verification.detail: Big O Speedrun records an independently checked proof and the score it supports.

Mathematics and formal verification.name: Conway’s 99-graph
Mathematics and formal verification.summary: Exact computations and structural bounds on a possible graph with 99 vertices and 14 neighbors at every vertex.
Mathematics and formal verification.detail: The existence question remains open. The project page presents the rook-grid bound and an interactive illustration.

Mathematics and formal verification.name: Erdős Problem 99
Mathematics and formal verification.summary: Collaborative research on unit equilateral triangles in minimum-diameter point configurations.
Mathematics and formal verification.detail: The repository records individual bounds, exclusion arguments and exact checks. The general problem remains open.

Mathematics and formal verification.name: Matrix multiplication bounds
Mathematics and formal verification.summary: Exact experiments, constructions and obstructions in the search for a better matrix multiplication exponent.
Mathematics and formal verification.detail: The research workspace tracks candidate methods with source statements and reproduction material. Consult individual results for the assumptions behind each bound.

Mathematics and formal verification.name: Catalan’s constant
Mathematics and formal verification.summary: Rational approximation experiments and written irrationality-exponent research on Catalan’s constant.
Mathematics and formal verification.detail: The repository links its written estimates and exact certificates. It records the verification limits and its relationship to the unresolved irrationality question.

Mathematics and formal verification.name: 3-SAT bounds
Mathematics and formal verification.summary: Research on worst-case 3-SAT algorithms, using exact support calculations and explicit accounting for running time.
Mathematics and formal verification.detail: The repository explores degree, partition capacity and other restrictions in attempts to refine subexponential methods.

Mathematics and formal verification.name: Dirichlet L-function zero-free bounds
Mathematics and formal verification.summary: Research on a common zero-free half-plane for Dirichlet L-functions.
Mathematics and formal verification.detail: The project documents structural obstructions and gaps with pinned literature and reproducible certificates.

Mathematics and formal verification.name: Integer multiplication bounds
Mathematics and formal verification.summary: Contributions to community research on a conditional integer multiplication exponent.
Mathematics and formal verification.detail: A contributed result is a three-dimensional contact-span construction. The research uses the original OpenAI #109 framework as a hypothesis.

Mathematics and formal verification.name: Van der Waerden refinement
Mathematics and formal verification.summary: A contributed conditional logarithmic endpoint bound in a refinement of a van der Waerden number estimate.
Mathematics and formal verification.detail: The upstream contribution records its explicit threshold and which analytic hypothesis is used.

Mathematics and formal verification.name: Sextic fourfold atlas
Mathematics and formal verification.summary: A contribution on elliptic residue contraction for a family of sextic fourfolds in the Hodge conjecture project.
Mathematics and formal verification.detail: The atlas and the contribution record give the exact family and supporting calculations.

Mathematics and formal verification.name: Big O Speedrun verifier
Mathematics and formal verification.summary: A contribution to independent Lean proof verification using Comparator and nanoda.
Mathematics and formal verification.detail: The linked upstream work records a replay of an integer certificate for a block-sensitivity result.

Mathematics and formal verification.name: Alpöge Lean archive
Mathematics and formal verification.summary: A mirror of Levent Alpöge’s Lean release and a separate community effort to replay the published proof artifacts.
Mathematics and formal verification.detail: Levent Alpöge is the original author of the proof release. The archive provides a public copy with provenance, and the replay project records individual checks.

Mathematics and formal verification.name: Riemann witness registry
Mathematics and formal verification.summary: An opt-in numbered time capsule for the November 20, 2026 announcement of the Riemann Hypothesis proof.
Mathematics and formal verification.detail: The public site describes the registry, how someone can take part and the visibility choices available to participants.

Tools and hardware.name: The Hack CPU
Tools and hardware.summary: A two-stage Hack processor in SystemVerilog with global-history branch prediction, branch recovery and fused instructions.
Tools and hardware.detail: The project page connects recorded simulation snapshots to the design decisions in the implementation.

Tools and hardware.name: IMSA schedule map
Tools and hardware.summary: An in-browser Rust and WebAssembly tool that turns PowerSchool class rows into printable room lists for the IMSA schedule.
Tools and hardware.detail: The app separates semesters and keeps class rows in the browser.

Tools and hardware.name: IMSA campus route planner
Tools and hardware.summary: A Rust fork of Epoch’s campus mapping project for finding routes between IMSA classrooms.
Tools and hardware.detail: The original application and fork are both linked. The separate schedule map organizes a student’s room list from class rows.

Tools and hardware.name: HP ACPI lock-order workaround
Tools and hardware.summary: An experimental local Linux workaround for a GBAP/ECMX lock-order deadlock found in some HP laptop firmware.
Tools and hardware.detail: The builder checks machine-specific bytecode before producing an override. The repository documents what has been tested and the conditions for using it.

Tools and hardware.name: Canvas LMS MCP
Tools and hardware.summary: A self-hosted Model Context Protocol connector for reading Canvas LMS course materials, assignments and submission status.
Tools and hardware.detail: The connector is read-only by default. The README documents its capabilities, configuration and validation limits.

Tools and hardware.name: Speed Savings Tracker
Tools and hardware.summary: A Firefox extension that measures the time saved when HTML5 videos play faster than normal.
Tools and hardware.detail: The project explains how playback time and speed contribute to the accumulated time savings.

Tools and hardware.name: Arch and Hyprland dotfiles
Tools and hardware.summary: A curated Arch Linux desktop configuration with Hyprland, status panels, media controls and day and night themes.
Tools and hardware.detail: The source tree documents how the public files fit together and what they depend on.

Tools and hardware.name: Cozi
Tools and hardware.summary: A command-line package manager for unofficial Vencord plugins.
Tools and hardware.detail: The repository contains the CLI guide and the plugin-management commands.

Tools and hardware.name: Maxwell for Vencord
Tools and hardware.summary: A Vencord plugin that displays a bouncing Maxwell cat GIF in a Discord window.
Tools and hardware.detail: The repository contains the plugin and documents how it is loaded by Vencord.

Tools and hardware.name: Timed messages for Vencord
Tools and hardware.summary: An experimental Vencord plugin that removes messages after a selected interval in a chosen channel.
Tools and hardware.detail: The upstream README records its limited testing and work-in-progress status.

Tools and hardware.name: Image distance measurer
Tools and hardware.summary: A small utility for measuring distances in an image by selecting points.
Tools and hardware.detail: The source is a personal utility shared with simple usage instructions.

Tools and hardware.name: Brainfuck interpreter
Tools and hardware.summary: A Java learning project that interprets the eight operations of the Brainfuck programming language.
Tools and hardware.detail: The public source is a small example of representing tape state and interpreting loops.

Tools and hardware.name: rEFInd boot theme
Tools and hardware.summary: A personal rEFInd boot-menu theme derived from the Terminal Bootloader project.
Tools and hardware.detail: The fork contains its own theme resources and credits the upstream project.

Tools and hardware.name: Buckshot Roulette CLI
Tools and hardware.summary: An existing command-line adaptation of Buckshot Roulette, distributed as a personal programming project.
Tools and hardware.detail: The repository contains the game’s source and its command-line rules.

Team and community work.name: Titan Robotics programming
Team and community work.summary: Programming leadership and robot software for Titan Robotics, FIRST Robotics Competition Team 2022.
Team and community work.detail: The linked contribution covers the 2026 Java intake subsystem. The team’s site documents the robot and competition season.

Team and community work.name: QB Reader contributions
Team and community work.summary: A contribution to the QB Reader quizbowl practice website that preserves the buzzpoint in generated tossup cards.
Team and community work.detail: The substantive change is documented in the upstream pull request. The profile also contains the source fork and two empty scratch repositories.

Team and community work.name: Epoch computing club website
Team and community work.summary: Updates to club events and site content for the Epoch computing club at IMSA.
Team and community work.detail: The upstream pull request records the website change.

Team and community work.name: Cinna Davis’s portfolio
Team and community work.summary: An interactive desk and project shelf for work in software, mathematics, acoustics, hardware and physics.
Team and community work.detail: The project includes a conventional browsing mode and connects the interactive exhibits to their public source material.

Small experiments and upstream forks.name: Discord terminal bot
Small experiments and upstream forks.summary: An older Rust Discord bot that uses Serenity and Ratatui for a terminal interface.

Small experiments and upstream forks.name: Pathfinding experiment
Small experiments and upstream forks.summary: A small repository for experimenting with pathfinding.

Small experiments and upstream forks.name: HTB Watcher
Small experiments and upstream forks.summary: A small monitoring utility for Hack The Box activity.

Small experiments and upstream forks.name: HyFetch fork
Small experiments and upstream forks.summary: A fork of the upstream HyFetch system information utility.

Small experiments and upstream forks.name: Encryptcord fork
Small experiments and upstream forks.summary: A fork of the upstream Encryptcord project.
